strongest_objections: The reviewed snapshot necessarily contains a null review_snapshot_commit, so candidate equality is not self-proven by that JSON alone. The closure contract resolves this by binding ef06069254d7e12d63039b3985bfe0c672f62882 as review_snapshot_commit, requiring package certification whose authenticated run head equals that commit, and accepting only the successful phase0-rollback-certification job from that exact-head run.

The durable recovery_position is an exact dynamic algorithm rather than a copy-paste operator script. It now removes the unsafe static candidate and nine-commit inventory, specifies the baseline-exclusive range and newest-first order, and is reproducible by a Git-capable operator, but novice execution still depends on understanding the documented Git primitives.

The rollback job installs validation dependencies before applying the reverts. That could weaken a future rehearsal if the candidate changed dependency declarations, although the reviewed baseline-to-snapshot diff changes neither requirements-dev.txt nor pyproject.toml, and the resulting tree exactly equals the baseline tree before baseline validation and ten regression tests pass.

The validator authenticates the exact-head successful rollback job through GitHub rather than parsing the uploaded receipt during closure. This is adequate for the reviewed immutable workflow because the inspected job generates the receipt only after full-range revert, tree equality, baseline validation, and tests succeed, but artifact retention remains a durability limitation.

The dynamic rollback artifact depends on the later allowlisted closure inserting review_snapshot_commit. Closure-delta tests, immutable snapshot loading, evidence-hash stability, and file allowlisting prevent that transition from changing the reviewed rollback procedure or executable controls.
residual_risks: The uploaded execution receipt is subject to GitHub artifact-retention policy, although the durable dynamic procedure remains reproducible.
The recovery instructions assume Git command-line proficiency and do not provide a separate cross-platform operator wrapper.
A future phase that changes dependency declarations must ensure rollback dependencies are resolved from the baseline rather than inherited from the candidate.

strongest_objections: The authenticated rollback receipt is retained as a GitHub Actions artifact, so its convenient availability is time-bounded even though the versioned dynamic procedure remains reproducible.

The operator recovery position specifies the correct dynamic boundary and newest-first range but leaves clean-worktree, backup, and conflict-handling precautions implicit rather than presenting a complete copy-and-run operator playbook.

The rollback rehearsal assumes a revertable linear commit range; the reviewed nineteen-commit range is linear and passed, but a future merge commit would require explicit mainline handling and should fail certification until supported.
Canonical closure authentication intentionally depends on GitHub API availability and therefore fails closed during a provider outage.
evidence_refs: GitHub Actions artifact phase0-rollback-receipt, artifact ID 8826662181, head ef06069254d7e12d63039b3985bfe0c672f62882
residual_risks: Artifact retention may require reproducing the rollback receipt from the immutable snapshot and workflow.
Operators should execute recovery in a clean disposable checkout and preserve the pre-recovery reference.
GitHub API or Actions outages temporarily prevent closure certification by design.

audit_findings.summary: Improvement-cycle approval could be forged with empty implementation and evidence arrays.

audit_findings.summary: Large modules and partial typing need ratchets that prevent new maintainability debt.

audit_findings.summary: Comparative inventory validation omits effective command and capability overlays.

audit_findings.summary: Most agent documents disagree with runtime capability skills or template selection.

audit_findings.summary: Agent handoff completion and specialist differentiation are incompletely measured.

audit_findings.summary: Legacy rendered-page fetching can follow a validated public URL to an unvalidated private redirect.

audit_findings.summary: Documentation certification, artifact counts, command authority, and source freshness exceed observed evidence.

learning_records.expected_result: The missing-review-snapshot regression fails closure regardless of whether the repository program is in progress or complete.

observed_evidence.assertion: The closure-state test inherited the live review snapshot instead of explicitly constructing the missing-snapshot counterexample.

learning_records.learning: Tests that load mutable canonical lifecycle state must explicitly normalize every field material to the counterexample they claim to construct.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: A lifecycle mutation test passes before closure but fails after a valid status transition because its target field was inherited rather than assigned.
learning_records.guardrail: Explicitly clear review_snapshot_commit, frozen_package_commit, and package_certification in the missing-snapshot regression before refreshing review state.

verification_evidence.assertion: All 428 tests pass in the six-environment matrix after explicit lifecycle-state normalization.

learning_records.rollback_position: Retain explicit lifecycle fixture setup or replace live-program loading with an equally deterministic fixture factory.
learning_records.residual_risk: Future lifecycle tests can repeat this mistake if they rely on mutable canonical defaults.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Freeze a new exact metadata snapshot and obtain two fresh independent approvals.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Durable rollback instructions must remain safe at the exact reviewed snapshot boundary without manual commit-list maintenance.
learning_records.expected_result: Operators and CI derive the complete baseline-exclusive commit range from review_snapshot_commit and revert every commit newest-first.

observed_evidence.assertion: The prior durable artifact embedded candidate 79f0908 and an obsolete nine-commit recovery position.

learning_records.learning: A successful dynamic CI rehearsal cannot make stale operator-facing recovery instructions safe; the durable procedure and authenticated execution receipt must agree on boundary semantics.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: The canonical rollback artifact embeds a fixed candidate or commit count that predates review_snapshot_commit.
learning_records.guardrail: Require the versioned dynamic procedure, canonical baseline, review_snapshot_commit selector, full baseline-exclusive range, newest-first order, baseline tree, canonical workflow job, and complete safety assertions.

verification_evidence.assertion: All 429 tests pass and stale rollback procedure mutations are rejected in every canonical environment.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve dynamic exact-snapshot derivation or replace it only with a stronger authenticated recovery manifest.
learning_records.residual_risk: The uploaded execution receipt remains subject to GitHub artifact retention, while the durable procedure remains reproducible.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Freeze and certify the new durable rollback contract before fresh independent review.

learning_records.affected_invariant: A rollback rehearsal must restore both content and the Git revision context before history-aware baseline validation starts.
learning_records.expected_result: The receipt preserves the candidate while HEAD, index tree, and tracked worktree align cleanly to the Phase 1 baseline.

observed_evidence.assertion: Tree restoration passed but baseline remediation validation rejected candidate-history files.

learning_records.learning: Tree equality is necessary but insufficient when restored validators inspect Git history; the disposable checkout revision boundary is part of the rollback state.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: The post-revert tree equals the baseline tree while git rev-parse HEAD still identifies the candidate.
learning_records.guardrail: After proving the revert tree, preserve candidate provenance in the receipt, soft-reset the disposable checkout to baseline, and assert HEAD, tree, index, and tracked worktree alignment before validation.

verification_evidence.assertion: Exact-head run 30728223423 passed the end-to-end recurrence test and phase-rollback-certification.

learning_records.rollback_position: Retain revision-context alignment or replace it only with an equivalent isolated baseline checkout after exact revert-tree proof.
learning_records.residual_risk: Untracked receipt files intentionally remain outside tracked-tree cleanliness checks until artifact upload.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Freeze the exact green Phase 1 package for two fresh independent reviews.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Phase closure must bind fresh authenticated provider state, reversible provider controls, operational truth, and immutable workflow dependencies.
learning_records.expected_result: Every externally enforced control is authenticated, fresh, rollback-planned, truthfully owned, and implemented with immutable action references.

observed_evidence.assertion: The hardened governance contract rejects stale provider capture, mutable actions, and unsupported operational claims.

learning_records.learning: A repository JSON boolean is not provider authentication, source rollback alone misses external mutations, enforced review can be operationally unavailable, and release tags are mutable dependencies.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: A closure package lacks a fresh authenticated provider check, exact pre-change provider state, executable dry-run rollback, named owner and due phase for reviewer onboarding, or full action commit pins.
learning_records.guardrail: Require owner-authenticated provider capture, live CI verification, versioned provider baseline, exact guarded rollback planner and dry run, truthful availability ownership, and immutable action SHAs.

verification_evidence.assertion: The exact-head run passed provider verification, 439 tests, security and quality gates, both rollback certifications, clean wheels, and repository certification.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve the authenticated provider baseline and guarded exact rollback path; replace either only with stronger provider-native evidence and recovery controls.
learning_records.residual_risk: Merge availability remains blocked until an eligible independent reviewer is onboarded in Phase 8.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Keep the reviewer-availability claim blocked and owner-assigned until provider evidence proves an eligible collaborator exists.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Least-privilege CI must verify every field it can observe without claiming privileged fields its integration token cannot see.
learning_records.expected_result: CI obtains its actor from trusted workflow context, live-verifies observable repository and ruleset fields, and uses only a fresh owner capture for explicitly classified privileged fields.

observed_evidence.assertion: The ruleset endpoint was accessible but omitted the privileged bypass_actors field, proving field-level visibility differs from endpoint access.

learning_records.learning: Provider-token visibility is field-specific: endpoint access does not imply visibility of every privileged field, and workflow identity should come from trusted CI context instead of an unnecessary user API call.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: CI returns 403 for the user endpoint or rejects a live ruleset response solely because an administrator-only field is omitted.
learning_records.guardrail: Use GITHUB_ACTOR for workflow identity, live-check all CI-visible settings, classify privileged fields explicitly, and require their owner capture to be less than 24 hours old at closure.

verification_evidence.assertion: The hybrid capture implementation passed the exact-head successful run 30729301597.

learning_records.rollback_position: Retain the least-privilege visibility split or replace it only when provider permissions and response fields are demonstrably stronger.
learning_records.residual_risk: An owner capture must be refreshed before closure whenever its 24-hour freshness window expires.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Run the authenticated hybrid provider verification on every closure candidate and fail closed on stale privileged evidence.
